items.title: Keep ZIP and 7z backups outside the active PS2 library
items.summary: Separate archival storage from EmuCoreX scan roots, verify an extracted working image before launch, prevent conflict copies, and retain compressed masters without making the scanner crawl or misidentify them.

items.title: Keep controller order stable after reconnecting
items.summary: Test controller identity across sleep, reversed reconnect order, and app restart, then preserve stable per-device profiles or document a deterministic connection sequence.

items.title: Map a controller with nonstandard button labels
items.summary: Map an unfamiliar controller by physical position and observed events, document every conversion to PS2 symbols, and test one press, release, diagonals, and shoulders.

items.title: Map a PlayStation-style Bluetooth controller for PS2
items.summary: Pair through Android, verify the active controller mode, bind familiar PlayStation positions without assuming pressure support, test sticks and triggers, and confirm the Bluetooth profile survives sleep and reconnect.

items.title: Map an Xbox-style controller for PS2 games
items.summary: Create a clean Port 1 profile by mapping PS2 functions from physical positions, testing both analog sticks, triggers, stick clicks, Start and Select, and proving one press produces one intended input after reconnect.

items.title: Match Android refresh rate to PS2 output
items.summary: Hold emulation speed and scene constant, compare available Android refresh modes, observe cadence rather than raw FPS, and retain the most stable display policy.

items.title: Measure shader-cache warm-up across cold and repeat PS2 launches
items.summary: Use a deterministic effect route across first visit, immediate replay, app restart, and optional system restart to learn which hitches disappear after pipeline compilation and whether the cache persists normally.

items.title: Measure sustained PS2 emulation performance instead of menu speed
items.summary: Define a ten-minute gameplay route, normalize battery, ambient conditions, power policy, and capture overhead, record interval timing from a cool start through steady temperature, and require two comparable runs.

items.title: Merge two PS2 library folders with a hash-led conflict table
items.summary: Consolidate two playable roots into a fresh destination by classifying identical hashes, regional revisions, multidisc sets, and patched working copies before EmuCoreX ever scans the merged folder.

items.title: Move an EmuCoreX PS2 library to an SD card without losing identity
items.summary: Copy verified personal images to removable storage, prove every byte arrived, switch the Android document-tree grant once, and retain the internal source until titles, regions, favorites, and cold boots all match.

items.title: Prepare an EmuCoreX library handoff to a new Android phone
items.summary: Inventory game roots, firmware references, memory cards, profiles, controller layouts, and hashes as separate restore layers, rehearse the import into an isolated folder, and keep the old phone unchanged until the new one passes.

items.title: Prevent accidental touchscreen inputs
items.summary: Reproduce accidental touch input, identify the active hit region, adjust separation or safe placement one control at a time, and retest grip, gestures, and release.

items.title: Dump and verify your own PlayStation 2 BIOS
items.summary: A legality-first BIOS workflow using a personally owned console, the official PCSX2 biosdrain guidance, two independent dumps, hashes, recovery steps, and checks that avoid sharing proprietary firmware.

items.title: Create and verify a personal PS2 disc image
items.summary: Dump an owned PS2 CD or DVD without altering it, preserve the correct track structure, verify the result, and recover cleanly from read errors before adding the image to EmuCoreX.

items.title: Use blending, mipmapping, deinterlacing, and GS fixes correctly
items.summary: Understand what four commonly confused graphics controls actually change, then apply the smallest game-specific correction with a visual baseline and a clean rollback.

items.title: Create, import, back up, and repair PS2 memory cards
items.summary: Manage PS2 memory cards as durable files: choose compatible sizes, preserve slot identity, make cold backups, import cautiously, and recover from corruption without sacrificing healthy saves.

items.title: Apply verified patches and cheats without altering the game image
items.summary: Match PNACH content to the exact game CRC and serial, preserve the original image, review every effect, test from a clean boot, and remove a patch without contaminating saves.

items.title: Rebuild EmuCoreX library metadata without replacing save data
items.summary: Distinguish covers and title cache from game images, profiles, memory cards, and states; back up the durable layers; refresh only metadata; and compare hashes before considering broader data resets.

items.title: Recognize misleading FPS readings in PS2 emulation
items.summary: Cross-check FPS with emulation speed, VPS, frame time, audio cadence, limiter state, title frame-rate design, and visible motion so duplicated or skipped presentation is not mistaken for correct full-speed gameplay.

items.title: Reduce background-app interference during PS2 emulation tests
items.summary: Identify periodic downloads, media capture, overlays, synchronization, and notification bursts by correlating hitch timestamps with Android activity, then remove one suspect at a time without disabling essential services blindly.

items.title: Reduce distant texture shimmer without blurring the PS2 image
items.summary: Build a repeatable camera route across roads, fences, or terrain, test mipmapping before anisotropic filtering, compare native and target resolution, and accept only a setting that stabilizes detail in motion.

items.title: Retire one EmuCoreX library root without deleting its files
items.summary: Map the exact entries owned by a root, remove only its Android tree grant, refresh once, prove other roots and saves remain intact, and handle physical files later as a separate owner-controlled action.

items.title: Rename PS2 working images while preserving serial and set identity
items.summary: Create a reversible filename map, rename only verified working copies, update cue references and multidisc labels, refresh once, and prove that EmuCoreX still links the correct region and per-game profile.

items.title: Restore the Android audio route after disconnecting a headset
items.summary: Record the active route, disconnect once, compare system media and PS2 audio, then rebuild only the emulator audio session or Android route needed for reliable recovery.

items.title: Keep PS2 regions and revisions separate in EmuCoreX
items.summary: Identify PAL, NTSC-U, NTSC-J, and revision-specific working images by serial, hash, video standard, and save compatibility so covers, profiles, patches, and memory-card tests never cross the wrong executable.

items.title: Set full or limited RGB range on an external display
items.summary: Use near-black and near-white reference steps to identify a range mismatch between Android, an adapter, receiver, and television; change one device at a time and preserve the input preset that shows every legal level.

items.title: Set up PS2 emulation on an external monitor
items.summary: Connect one documented display chain, verify negotiated mode, aspect, overscan, game mode, audio route, controller response, and power stability against the phone baseline.

items.title: Set up two local PS2 controllers
items.summary: Build Port 2 from a known-good two-player baseline, test each controller alone and together, and prove device order remains correct after disconnecting both pads.

items.title: Split a large EmuCoreX library into non-overlapping roots
items.summary: Design internal, SD-card, and temporary roots with explicit ownership, move one collection segment at a time, prevent parent-child overlap, and reconcile physical-image counts with EmuCoreX entries.

items.title: Validate a PS2 widescreen patch without breaking the HUD
items.summary: Match the patch to the exact serial and revision, compare field of view rather than stretch, inspect culling, HUD anchors, FMV, scripted cameras, and rollback cleanly when one segment fails.

items.title: Test Android Battery Saver impact on PS2 emulation
items.summary: Compare a fixed PS2 route with Battery Saver explicitly off and on, while holding charge level, temperature, brightness, renderer, and background activity constant, then document whether speed loss comes from system power policy.

items.title: Test anisotropic filtering without creating texture artifacts
items.summary: Use one oblique road or floor and a separate sprite-heavy scene to measure whether anisotropic filtering stabilizes distant detail, preserves texture-atlas borders, and remains correct across renderer APIs.

items.title: Test Bluetooth audio without hiding controller latency
items.summary: Use the phone picture as the input reference, compare local and Bluetooth sound routes, and record controller-to-visual delay separately from visual-to-audio delay.

items.title: Use frame skipping only as a PS2 performance diagnostic
items.summary: Run a brief A/B test to learn whether reducing presented frames changes emulation speed, input, audio, and scene timing, then restore the original value instead of treating visual discontinuity as a universal performance fix.

items.title: Test higher blending accuracy without hiding its performance cost
items.summary: Choose an effects-heavy checkpoint, raise blending one tier at a time, compare against software correctness, measure warm frame time and readbacks, and retain only the lowest level that repairs the required pass.

items.title: Test PS2 emulation performance after an Android system update
items.summary: Re-run saved baseline routes after an Android update, recording build, driver, power policy, permissions, cache state, and cold versus warm behavior before attributing a regression to the emulator or changing many settings.

items.title: Test PS2 audio with Android sound enhancements disabled
items.summary: Capture Android audio processing, disable one enhancement at a time, compare the same PS2 passage at matched volume, and distinguish route processing from emulation speed.

items.title: Tune internal resolution for sustained PS2 emulation speed
items.summary: Test resolution multipliers through the heaviest known route, allow the device to reach steady temperature, require two long passes with headroom, and reject the highest opening-scene setting when late gameplay falls behind.

items.title: Tune touchscreen opacity and size for readability
items.summary: Tune touch controls against bright and dark game scenes, changing opacity, size, and position separately so inputs remain readable without covering essential PS2 content.

items.title: Use a USB controller through Android OTG
items.summary: Validate OTG host mode, data capability, power stability, Android events, and one device-specific PS2 mapping before trusting a wired controller session.

items.title: Test a USB drive as temporary EmuCoreX library storage
items.summary: Qualify an OTG adapter, power path, filesystem, document-tree grant, sustained reads, and safe eject behavior with copied test images while keeping emulator data and the verified source elsewhere.

items.title: Repair CUE track references after renaming a PS2 CD working copy
items.summary: Preserve the master cue/bin set, audit every FILE entry and track order, update only a disposable working cue, verify unchanged BIN hashes, and test data plus audio before rescanning EmuCoreX.

items.title: Verify a graphics fix across PS2 regions and revisions
items.summary: Treat each serial and executable CRC as an independent target, establish clean baselines, apply the fix only where its metadata matches, and prove that another region does not inherit unnecessary or unsafe settings.

items.title: Calculate working space before a PS2 library migration
items.summary: Measure source bytes, destination free bytes, largest-file limits, temporary verification space, and safety margin before copying; verify in batches so a full destination cannot produce silent truncation.

items.title: Verify logs and screenshots after changing the emulator data folder
items.summary: After relocating emulator data, create one uniquely named screenshot and one marked log session, confirm both land only in the new paths, survive app restart, and remain writable before deleting or archiving the old folder.
